description: Parentheses in an interpolation of a quoted template can contain newlines
notes: The spec describes a quoted template as a single-line expression, but it also says newlines are ignored between the parentheses of a sub-expression, which an interpolation may contain. That wording is the only conflict. hashicorp/hcl accepts it: parseExpressionTerm in hclsyntax/parser.go ignores newlines inside parentheses.
